name: Mercury
tagline: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun — a cratered world of extremes.
history: Mercury is the smallest planet in the Solar System and completes an orbit every 88 days — the fastest of any planet, which is why Romans named it for their swift messenger god. Locked in a 3:2 spin-orbit resonance, it rotates exactly three times for every two orbits. Its cratered surface records billions of years of impacts, and NASA's MESSENGER orbiter (2011–2015) found water ice hiding in permanently shadowed polar craters despite noon temperatures of 427 °C. Only three spacecraft have visited: Mariner 10 flew by in 1974–75, MESSENGER orbited a decade ago, and the joint ESA/JAXA BepiColombo mission is en route to enter orbit in 2026.
